name: The Rep (Birmingham Repertory Theatre)
accessibility:
Fully step-free street-level entrance directly off Centenary Square with automated power-assisted doors. Modern passenger lifts provide step-free access across all public auditorium levels, including The House (Main Stage), The Door, and The Studio.

  • Wheelchair Spaces: Dedicated wheelchair positions and level-transfer seats are available across every performance space with adjacent companion seating.
  • Lift Access: Passenger lifts serve all foyer, bar, and auditorium tiers across all three stages.
  • Assisted Hearing: Sennheiser radio frequency assistive hearing and induction loop systems are available to collect from the access desk.
  • Accessible Facilities: Modern accessible and Changing Places toilet facilities are located on the ground floor. Unisex cubicles on the first floor allow plenty of space for parents with small children.
  • Parking: Blue Badge bays are located nearby on Centenary Square and Cambridge Street, with Q-Park Brindleyplace within a short step-free walk.
relaxed:
The Rep is a national beacon for accessible theatre, scheduling dedicated Relaxed, Audio Described, Captioned, and British Sign Language (BSL) interpreted performances across all major productions and family seasons.

  • Auditorium Environment: Relaxed shows feature gently illuminated auditorium house lights, moderated sound effects without startling spikes or sudden pyrotechnics, and no complete blackouts.
  • Open-Door Policy: A flexible open-door policy allows families and neurodivergent audience members to come, go, move, and vocalise freely throughout the performance.
  • Calm Breakout Spaces: Quiet breakout zones and sensory chill-out rooms equipped with calming aids are provided in the foyers, supported by welcoming, specially trained front-of-house access hosts.
  • Family Comfort: The Rep offers comfortable spacious seating throughout, with more than the average amount of leg room making it a fantastic venue for all.

name: Birmingham Hippodrome
accessibility:
Step-free access is available throughout the venue via automatic main entrance doors on Hurst Street and Thorp Street, with multiple passenger lifts connecting all auditorium levels from the Main Foyer.

  • Wheelchair Spaces: Dedicated wheelchair spaces and companion seating are located across both the Stalls and Circle levels.
  • Lift Access: Modern passenger lifts provide full step-free access to all public floors, bars, restaurant spaces, the Patrick Studio, and main auditorium seating.
  • Assisted Hearing: Sennheiser infrared sound enhancement system installed throughout the auditorium; headsets and personal neck loops are available from the access desk in the main foyer.
  • Accessible Facilities: Fully accessible unisex toilets located on all levels, including enlarged cubicles designed with ample room for adults and young children.
  • Family Comfort: Booster seats are available on request at the entrance doors to both the Stalls and Circle for younger theatregoers.
  • Essential Companion: Integrated with the Nimbus Access Card scheme to provide free companion tickets for eligible guests.
relaxed:
Birmingham Hippodrome provides dedicated Relaxed, British Sign Language (BSL) interpreted, Audio Described, and Captioned performances for major West End tours, studio shows, and the annual pantomime.

  • Auditorium Environment: House lighting remains on at a gentle level throughout; dramatic volume peaks, sudden pyrotechnics, strobe flashes, and loud sound effects are reduced or softened.
  • Open-Door Policy: Families enjoy full freedom of movement and vocalisation, allowing children and attendees to enter and exit the auditorium whenever needed.
  • Calm Breakout Spaces: Designated quiet chill-out zones and sensory breakout rooms are staffed and available in the foyer spaces for anyone needing downtime. The foyer at Birmingham Hippodrome provides a welcome respite with large open spaces and plenty of comfortable seating.
  • Sensory Aids: Sensory visual stories, ear defenders, fidget kits, and familiarisation guides can be accessed prior to your visit to prepare neurodivergent children for the theatre experience.

name: The Alexandra Theatre
accessibility:
Step-free street access is available directly to the Stalls via the dedicated accessible entrance on Station Street (intercom connected, met by an Access Host).

  • Wheelchair Spaces: Up to 8 dedicated wheelchair positions with step-free transfer seating and adjacent companion seats are available along the Stalls aisles.
  • Lift & Stair Notice: Please note the venue does not have a customer lift; the Dress Circle and Grand Upper Circle are accessible via stairs only.
  • Assisted Hearing: Sennheiser infrared and induction loop systems are available to borrow at the box office.
  • Accessible Facilities: A ground-floor RADAR-key accessible toilet is located on the Stalls level. General bathrooms are on the small side due to the historic age of the venue.
  • Essential Companion: Operates the ATG Access Membership scheme (powered by Nimbus Access Card) for online accessible and companion booking.
relaxed:
The Alexandra regularly schedules dedicated Relaxed, Audio Described, Captioned, and BSL-interpreted performances for touring musicals and visiting family productions.

  • Auditorium Environment: During relaxed performances, house lighting remains on low throughout the show, abrupt lighting transitions are moderated, and sudden loud sound spikes or pyrotechnics are softened.
  • Open-Door Policy: An open-door policy permits families to come and go from the auditorium freely at any point.
  • Calm Breakout Spaces: Dedicated quiet breakout spaces and foyer chill-out areas are available for sensory decompression, supported by trained Access Hosts. The upstairs lounge and bar area is a great space to decompress during the performance if necessary and the team are fantastic!

name: MAC (Midlands Arts Centre)
accessibility:
Fully step-free ground-floor access is available from both the Queen's Ride car park entrance and the Cannon Hill Park entrance via automatic sliding doors.

  • Wheelchair Spaces: Dedicated wheelchair positions and step-free transfer seating are available across the Main Theatre, Foyle Studio, Hexagon Theatre, and Cinema.
  • Lift Access: Spacious passenger lifts connect all public levels, galleries, studios, café spaces, and upper auditorium entrances.
  • Accessible Facilities & Changing Places: Equipped with a full ground-floor Changing Places toilet (complete with adult-sized height-adjustable bench, ceiling hoist, and RADAR key access) alongside accessible unisex toilets and baby-changing rooms on every floor.
  • Assisted Hearing: Infrared and induction loop systems operate across the Theatre, Cinema, and Box Office counters.
  • Parking: Extensive Blue Badge parking bays are located directly outside the main Queen's Ride entrance.
relaxed:
MAC is one of the Midlands' leading hubs for early-years theatre, family festive productions, and neurodivergent-friendly arts programming.

  • Auditorium Environment: Relaxed and chilled performances keep auditorium lighting softly illuminated, eliminate startling strobe or smoke effects, and maintain gentle, balanced sound levels ideal for toddlers and sensory-sensitive children.
  • Open-Door Policy: A relaxed attitude to noise and movement is standard at MAC's family and relaxed shows, allowing children to move around or step outside at any time.
  • Calm Breakout Space: Quiet seating areas in the upper foyers and immediate step-free access into Cannon Hill Park offer calm decompression spaces before, during, and after shows.
  • Sensory Aids: Pre-visit visual stories, ear defenders, and free Essential Companion tickets are available via the MAC Box Office.

name: Symphony Hall & Town Hall (B:Music)
accessibility:
Step-free level access into Symphony Hall is directly off Centenary Square into the modern glazed foyer, with automatic doors and wide, level concourses throughout.

  • Wheelchair Spaces: Dedicated wheelchair positions and companion seats are available across the Stalls, Choir, Circle, Upper Circle, and Grand Tier at Symphony Hall, and in the Stalls and Lower Gallery at Town Hall.
  • Lift Access: Multiple large passenger lifts serve every tier of Symphony Hall and Town Hall directly from the foyers.
  • Accessible Facilities & Changing Places: Symphony Hall provides accessible unisex toilets on every level plus access to a full Changing Places facility within the adjacent ICC mall.
  • Assisted Hearing: Sennheiser MobileConnect Wi-Fi assistive listening and induction loop systems cover all auditorium tiers.
  • Parking: Blue Badge drop-off is located on Centenary Square and Cambridge Street, with accessible bays in the Q-Park Brindleyplace and Paradise car parks.
relaxed:
B:Music hosts regular Relaxed family concerts, CBeebies live orchestral events, festive screenings of The Snowman with live orchestra, and interactive children's music workshops.

  • Auditorium Environment: Relaxed family concerts feature gently lit auditoriums, shorter programme durations without restrictive silence rules, and clear advance explanations of loud brass or percussion moments.
  • Open-Door Policy: Families can freely enter and exit the auditorium into the spacious Jennifer Blackwell Performance Space and foyers at any point.
  • Calm Breakout Space: The redesigned Centenary Square foyers provide expansive, light-filled quiet corners and step-free breakout seating away from crowd bottlenecks.
  • Sensory Aids: Downloadable visual stories, ear defenders on loan from the Welcome Desk, and free Essential Companion tickets via the B:Music Access Scheme.

name: Utilita Arena Birmingham
accessibility:
Step-free concourse access is available via the main Olympus Avenue / Canal-side entrances (Entrance E & G) with lift connections from the Arena car parks.

  • Wheelchair Spaces: Purpose-built raised accessible viewing platforms with adjacent companion seating are located across Blocks 1, 2, 3, 12, and floor levels.
  • Lift Access: Passenger lifts connect the West Car Park directly to the main concourse and accessible seating tiers.
  • Accessible Facilities & Changing Places: Features a dedicated Changing Places facility (complete with hoist, adult changing bench, and accessible shower) alongside RADAR-key accessible toilets around the concourse.
  • Assisted Hearing: Induction loops are fitted at box office and concourse service points, with assistive listening packs available on request in advance.
  • Parking: Pre-bookable Blue Badge parking bays are located in the West Car Park with direct lift access to the arena entrance.
relaxed:
Hosting large-scale family arena spectacles including Disney On Ice, Hot Wheels Monster Trucks, Strictly Come Dancing Live, and family pop concerts, Utilita Arena has dedicated sensory provisions for neurodivergent visitors.

  • Sensory Room & Calm Spaces: A dedicated quiet/sensory breakout room is available away from the main arena bowl noise; parents should request access via the Accessibility Team or stewarding staff upon arrival.
  • Auditorium Environment: Arena shows frequently use pyrotechnics, strobe lighting, and high decibel sound; specific show effect warnings are posted at concourse entrances and available from the Access Team prior to arrival.
  • Sensory Aids: Visitors are welcome to bring sensory bags, ear defenders, and medical/dietary essentials through the dedicated accessible fast-track entrance lanes.
  • Essential Companion: Partnered with the Nimbus Access Card scheme for online accessible platform and free Personal Assistant ticket bookings.

name: BP Pulse LIVE (NEC Arena)
accessibility:
Step-free level access is provided across the main piazza and Forum concourse at the NEC campus, with dedicated accessible priority entry lanes.

  • Wheelchair Spaces: Dedicated raised wheelchair viewing platforms and step-free seating bays with companion seats are positioned around the arena bowl.
  • Lift Access: Passenger lifts provide step-free access between the ground-level concourse and arena seating concourses.
  • Accessible Facilities & Changing Places: Equipped with a full Changing Places toilet (located near EntranceG/H on the main concourse with ceiling hoist and adult bench) plus RADAR-key accessible toilets throughout the venue.
  • Parking & Drop-Off: Dedicated Blue Badge parking is situated in Car Park East 1 (closest to the arena piazza) with step-free paved walkways directly to the doors.
  • Essential Companion: Uses the Nimbus Access Card / Arena Access Registration for booking wheelchair bays, ambulant seating, and free companion tickets.
relaxed:
As a major Midlands home for Disney On Ice, Cirque du Soleil, and family arena tours, BP Pulse LIVE offers practical support for families managing sensory overload in a large venue environment.

  • Quiet Breakout Space: A designated quiet/first-aid decompression space away from the main concourse crowds can be accessed at any time by speaking with any arena steward or Customer Services desk.
  • Sensory Preparation: Detailed show-day effect sheets (listing exact times of pyrotechnics, lasers, strobe lighting, and loud bangs) are available at the Information Desk on the main concourse.
  • Fast-Track Entry: Accessible entrance lanes help neurodivergent children bypass long, crowded turnstile queues before the show.
  • Sensory Aids: Families are encouraged to bring ear defenders and fidget aids; sensory exemption passes for medical/dietary bags can be arranged via the venue's Accessibility Team.

name: Wolverhampton Grand Theatre
accessibility:
Level access entrance from Lichfield Street leads directly into the main foyer and Stalls.

  • Wheelchair Spaces & Lift Access: A modern passenger lift connects all three levels (Stalls, Dress Circle, and Grand Circle). 8 dedicated wheelchair spaces are available across the auditorium alongside secure walking aid storage managed by front-of-house staff.
  • Accessible Facilities: 5 accessible adapted toilets are distributed across all tiers with step-free access, with baby changing facilities integrated within accessible cubicles.
  • Assisted Hearing: Sennheiser infrared assisted listening system and induction loops are installed across the auditorium.
  • Access Scheme: Free Access Register offering essential companion tickets at no charge, priority booking, and discounted access pricing.
relaxed:
Sensory-Friendly / Relaxed Shows: Regular relaxed and chilled stagings are scheduled for the annual pantomime and touring family productions.

  • Auditorium Environment: Features low auditorium house lighting, lowered sound volume, elimination of strobe and pyrotechnic effects, and complete freedom to exit and re-enter.
  • Calm Breakout Space: Designated calm/quiet breakout rooms are equipped with video monitors relaying the performance live for decompression away from the main auditorium.
  • Sensory Aids & Touch Tours: Sensory packs are available on request (including ear defenders and sensory toys), alongside pre-visit visual story packs, orientation sessions, and tactile Touch Tours before Audio Described shows.
  • Assistance Animals: Assistance dogs are welcome in the auditorium or can be cared for by volunteer staff during the show.

name: Lichfield Garrick Theatre
accessibility:
Step-free level access is available via automatic double doors from both Castle Dyke and Wade Street entrances. A central passenger lift serves all six levels, connecting the Box Office, Café Bar, Main Auditorium (Stalls and Circle), and the Studio.

  • Wheelchair Spaces: 4 dedicated spaces in the Main Auditorium (Row O) and 4 spaces in the Studio/Cinema, with adjacent companion seating.
  • Assisted Hearing: Sennheiser infrared hearing enhancement and fixed induction loop systems across both performance spaces.
  • Accessible Facilities: 3 unisex accessible toilets located on the Café Bar level, beside Door B, and in the Lounge Bar.
  • Essential Companion: Registered with the Nimbus Access Card scheme for free essential companion tickets.
  • Parking: Blue Badge on-street parking bays are located nearby on Wade Street and Castle Dyke.
relaxed:
The Lichfield Garrick regularly schedules dedicated relaxed and sensory-adapted performances for major family titles and seasonal pantomimes.

  • Auditorium Environment: House lights remain softly on throughout the show; sudden loud sound effects, strobe lighting, and pyrotechnics are removed or softened.
  • Open-Door Policy: Audience members have complete freedom to move, vocalise, and exit or re-enter the auditorium freely during the performance.
  • Calm Breakout Space: A quiet chill-out breakout area is available near the auditorium for anyone needing a break from sensory stimuli.
  • Sensory Aids: Booster cushions and ear defenders are available to borrow directly from the Box Office on arrival.

name: Stafford Gatehouse Theatre
accessibility:
Step-free street-level access is available directly via the main automated glass entrance on Eastgate Street, leading straight into the Box Office and Coffee Shop foyer.

  • Wheelchair Spaces: Dedicated wheelchair spaces are available in the Main Auditorium (Row N and Row A) and the versatile MET Studio, featuring step-free access and adjacent companion seating.
  • Lift Access: A central passenger lift connects the ground floor foyer to all public levels, including the Circle bar, balcony seating, and the MET Studio.
  • Assisted Hearing: An induction loop system is fitted in the Main Auditorium and Box Office counter; Sennheiser infrared enhancement headsets are available from front of house.
  • Accessible Facilities: Dedicated, fully adapted unisex accessible toilets are located on the ground floor foyer and upper studio levels.
  • Parking: Designated on-street Blue Badge parking bays are available directly opposite on Eastgate Street, with accessible spaces located in the nearby North Walls and Earl Street car parks.
relaxed:
Stafford Gatehouse Theatre regularly schedules relaxed, dementia-friendly, and British Sign Language (BSL) interpreted performances for seasonal family productions and the annual Christmas pantomime.

  • Auditorium Environment: Auditorium lighting remains on at a low, reassuring level with no complete blackouts; sudden loud bangs, pyrotechnics, strobe lighting, and dramatic sound effects are reduced or removed.
  • Open-Door Policy: Audience members have complete freedom of movement, allowing families and children to vocalise, stand, and enter or exit the auditorium freely throughout the performance.
  • Calm Breakout Space: A designated quiet chill-out room is provided outside the auditorium with comfortable seating and reduced sensory input for anyone needing time out.
  • Sensory Aids: Visual stories and familiarisation guides can be downloaded prior to your visit, and booster cushions are available on request at the Box Office.

name: Regent Theatre
accessibility:
Step-free level access is available directly into the main foyer and Box Office, with accessible routes leading to the Stalls auditorium.

  • Wheelchair Spaces: Dedicated wheelchair positions are located in the rear of the Stalls (Row X), featuring flat, step-free access and companion seating adjacent.
  • Lift Access: A passenger lift provides access between the foyer, lower bar, and Stalls level. Please note the Circle and Balcony levels are accessed via stairs and are not step-free.
  • Assisted Hearing: MobileConnect Wi-Fi sound amplification system is available across the auditorium via smartphone app or borrowed venue devices, alongside fixed induction loops.
  • Accessible Facilities: Fully adapted unisex accessible toilets are located on the Stalls level foyer.
  • Parking & Drop-Off: Dedicated Blue Badge parking bays and drop-off zones are available nearby on Pall Mall and Bethesda Street, with multi-storey parking at The Potteries Centre.
relaxed:
The Regent Theatre hosts dedicated relaxed, captioned, audio-described, and British Sign Language (BSL) interpreted performances for major touring shows and annual family pantomimes.

  • Auditorium Environment: House lights remain on at a low, gentle level throughout; dramatic lighting contrasts, strobe effects, loud pyrotechnics, and sudden bangs are reduced or removed.
  • Open-Door Policy: Families and attendees have full freedom of movement and vocalisation, allowing guests to enter and exit the auditorium as needed without restriction.
  • Quiet Chill-Out Space: A designated quiet breakout room is available nearby for anyone requiring sensory downtime during the visit.
  • Sensory Aids: Visual stories and venue access guides can be requested ahead of visits, and front-of-house staff are trained to support neurodivergent visitors.

name: New Vic Theatre
accessibility:
Step-free level access leads directly from the theatre's own car park into the main foyer, Box Office, café, and ground-floor auditorium entrances.

  • Wheelchair Spaces: As Europe's first purpose-built theatre-in-the-round, dedicated step-free wheelchair spaces and transfer seats are positioned right at stage level with excellent sightlines and adjacent companion seating.
  • Lift Access: A customer lift connects the ground-floor foyer and café with the upper balcony foyer and bar.
  • Assisted Hearing: Sennheiser infrared hearing enhancement and induction loop systems cover the entire in-the-round auditorium; headsets and neck loops are free to borrow from the Box Office.
  • Accessible Facilities: Accessible toilets and baby-changing facilities are located on both the ground and first floors.
  • Parking: On-site Blue Badge parking bays are situated right outside the main entrance doors (free for Blue Badge holders).
relaxed:
The New Vic is renowned across Staffordshire and the Midlands for its imaginative festive family adventures (such as The Borrowers, Alice in Wonderland, and The Nutcracker) and its early-years Tale Trail experiences.

  • Auditorium Environment: Dedicated Relaxed, Audio Described (with tactile Touch Tours), Captioned, and BSL performances are scheduled for all major family runs, featuring softened lighting, reduced sound peaks, and no sudden blackouts.
  • Open-Door Policy: A warm, informal atmosphere allows children and families to step out into the foyer and return whenever needed.
  • Calm Breakout Space: Quiet foyer areas with live audio/video relay and comfortable seating are set aside during relaxed matinees for sensory breaks.
  • Sensory Aids: Detailed pre-show visual stories, sonic/sensory trigger guides, and free Essential Companion tickets are provided by the New Vic Box Office.

name: Belgrade Theatre
accessibility:
Fully step-free street-level access is available from Belgrade Plaza directly into the spacious ground-floor foyer, Box Office, and Nineteen 58 café bar.

  • Wheelchair Spaces: Dedicated wheelchair positions and step-free transfer seats are available in both the Main Stage auditorium (Stalls and Circle) and the flexible B2 auditorium.
  • Lift Access: Passenger lifts connect the main foyer to all upper Circle, B2, and Burbidge Room levels.
  • Assisted Hearing: Infrared and induction loop assistive listening systems are installed in both auditoria, with headsets available from the Box Office.
  • Accessible Facilities: Accessible unisex toilets are located on the ground floor and all upper foyer tiers, alongside baby-changing facilities.
  • Parking: Adjacent Belgrade Plaza multi-storey car park provides designated Blue Badge bays and lift access directly onto the theatre plaza.
relaxed:
Belgrade Theatre schedules dedicated Relaxed, BSL Interpreted, Captioned, and Audio Described performances across its rock 'n' roll family pantomime, B2 Santa shows, and visiting children's tours.

  • Auditorium Environment: Relaxed performances keep house lights dimmed rather than dark, remove strobe lighting and sudden pyrotechnic bangs, and soften overall sound levels.
  • Open-Door Policy: Families can move freely, vocalise, and leave or re-enter the auditorium at any point during the show.
  • Calm Breakout Space: Quiet chill-out areas in the spacious upper foyers are set up during relaxed performances for sensory decompression.
  • Sensory Aids: Pre-visit visual stories, familiarisation notes, and tactile Touch Tours (ahead of audio-described shows) are available via the Box Office.

name: Warwick Arts Centre
accessibility:
Following a major multi-million-pound redevelopment, Warwick Arts Centre offers completely step-free level access across its entire ground-floor piazza entrance, foyers, Mead Gallery, and Benugo café.

  • Wheelchair Spaces: Generous wheelchair bays and step-free seating are integrated into the Butterworth Hall, Theatre, Studio, and all three cinema screens.
  • Lift Access: Multiple modern passenger lifts serve every floor, gallery, studio, and auditorium tier.
  • Accessible Facilities & Changing Places: Features a dedicated ground-floor Changing Places toilet (with ceiling track hoist, adult-sized adjustable changing bench, and shower) plus accessible gender-neutral and unisex toilets on every level.
  • Assisted Hearing: Sennheiser infrared and induction loop systems operate across all performance spaces and cinema screens.
  • Parking: Blue Badge parking bays are located immediately adjacent to the venue on the University of Warwick campus with flat, step-free access to the front doors.
relaxed:
Warwick Arts Centre is a flagship family arts venue in the Midlands, hosting month-long Julia Donaldson Christmas adaptations (such as The Gruffalo's Child and Stick Man), family circus, and relaxed cinema screenings.

  • Auditorium Environment: Virtually all family theatre productions operate on a welcoming 'Chilled' or Relaxed basis, with gentle auditorium lighting, moderated sound levels, and an inclusive atmosphere for neurodivergent children.
  • Open-Door Policy: Audience members are free to move, make noise, and come and go from the auditorium whenever they need a break.
  • Calm Breakout Space: Extensive quiet foyer zones, creative family drop-in spaces, and designated chill-out rooms are available throughout the building.
  • Sensory Aids: Ear defenders, sensory bags, visual stories, and free Essential Companion tickets are readily available from the Box Office.

name: Royal Shakespeare Theatre (RSC)
accessibility:
Step-free level access runs throughout the RSC riverfront complex, linking the Royal Shakespeare Theatre, Swan Theatre, and The Other Place via wide, flat foyers and automatic doors.

  • Wheelchair Spaces: Dedicated step-free wheelchair spaces and transfer seats are located around the thrust stage in the Stalls and Circle of both the Royal Shakespeare Theatre and Swan Theatre.
  • Lift Access: Scenic passenger lifts connect the ground-floor Colonnade foyer to the Circle, Upper Circle, Rooftop Restaurant, and Viewing Tower.
  • Accessible Facilities & Changing Places: A fully equipped Changing Places toilet (with ceiling hoist and adult changing bench) is located on the ground floor near the Swan Wing, alongside accessible toilets on every level.
  • Assisted Hearing: Sennheiser MobileConnect Wi-Fi and infrared assistive listening systems are installed in all auditoria.
  • Parking: Dedicated RSC Blue Badge parking bays are available directly outside the main Waterside entrance (pre-bookable through the Access Box Office).
relaxed:
The RSC is an industry pioneer in Chilled, Relaxed, BSL-integrated, Captioned, and Audio Described family theatre (famous for originating Matilda The Musical and staging major festive family productions).

  • Auditorium Environment: Chilled and Relaxed performances soften sudden sound and lighting cues, keep low ambient lighting in the auditorium, and welcome vocalisation and movement.
  • Open-Door Policy: Guests can leave and re-enter the auditorium at any time, with live video screens in the foyer relaying the action on stage.
  • Calm Breakout Space: Dedicated quiet breakout spaces and riverfront terraces offer peaceful sensory decompression during performances.
  • Sensory Aids: Free sensory backpacks (containing ear defenders, fidget tools, and visual cue cards), detailed sonic/sensory synopses, and tactile Touch Tours are available for every family show.

name: Curve Theatre
accessibility:
Designed as a modern, fully inclusive single-level street concourse, Curve's glass-fronted foyer wraps directly around the Theatre and Studio with completely step-free street access from Rutland Street and Halford Street.

  • Wheelchair Spaces: Extensive step-free wheelchair bays and companion seats are available across the Stalls and Circle in the 970-seat Theatre and the 350-seat Studio.
  • Lift Access: Large passenger lifts connect the street-level foyer to the Circle, Mezzanine bars, and upper rehearsal/workshop spaces.
  • Accessible Facilities & Changing Places: Features a full Changing Places toilet on the ground floor (with hoist, adult changing bench, and height-adjustable basin) plus accessible toilets across all levels.
  • Assisted Hearing: Sennheiser infrared and MobileConnect Wi-Fi assistive listening systems operate in both performance spaces.
  • Parking: Blue Badge bays and accessible parking are located directly opposite in the NCP Rutland Centre multi-storey car park.
relaxed:
Curve is one of the UK's foremost producing theatres for major family musicals, Julia Donaldson adaptations, and festive blockbusters, with comprehensive neurodivergent access built into every season.

  • Auditorium Environment: Dedicated Relaxed and Dementia-Friendly performances feature raised house lighting, reduced audio peaks, removal of strobe lighting, and an informal, supportive environment.
  • Open-Door Policy: Full freedom to leave and return to the auditorium at any time during the show, with foyer screens showing the live stage relay.
  • Calm Breakout Space: Dedicated quiet chill-out rooms with soft seating and sensory lighting are staffed during all relaxed performances.
  • Sensory Aids: Ear defenders, fidget packs, pre-visit visual stories, Touch Tours, and free Essential Companion tickets via Curve's Access Register.

name: Derby Theatre
accessibility:
Located directly within the Derbion centre with step-free lift and level access from the Theatre Car Park (Level 2) straight into the lower and upper theatre foyers.

  • Wheelchair Spaces: Dedicated wheelchair positions and step-free transfer seats are located in Row H of the Main Auditorium and in the Studio.
  • Lift Access: Passenger lifts connect the car park level, Box Office foyer, Café Bar, Main Auditorium, and Studio.
  • Accessible Facilities & Changing Places: Accessible unisex toilets are located on both foyer levels, with a full Changing Places facility situated steps away on Level 2 of the adjacent Derbion centre.
  • Assisted Hearing: Infrared and induction loop systems cover the Main House and Studio, complemented by Derby Theatre's sector-leading creative captioning.
  • Parking: Blue Badge parking spaces are situated in the Basement and Level 2 of the Theatre Car Park directly below the venue.
relaxed:
Derby Theatre is nationally celebrated for integrating British Sign Language (BSL), creative captioning, and audio description directly into its Christmas family productions and children's shows.

  • Auditorium Environment: Relaxed performances maintain gentle auditorium lighting, soften loud sound effects and lighting flashes, and feature integrated accessible storytelling on stage.
  • Open-Door Policy: A relaxed, welcoming approach to audience noise and movement allows families to step out to the foyer and return whenever needed.
  • Calm Breakout Space: A dedicated quiet room is provided away from the busy foyer during family and relaxed performances.
  • Sensory Aids: Ear defenders, booster seats, downloadable visual stories, pre-show Touch Tours, and free Essential Companion tickets via the Access Register.

name: Theatre Royal & Royal Concert Hall
accessibility:
Step-free level access is available into both the Theatre Royal (via the South Sherwood Street entrance) and the Royal Concert Hall (via the main glass foyer on Theatre Square).

  • Wheelchair Spaces: Dedicated wheelchair positions and companion seats are located in the Stalls and Dress Circle of the Theatre Royal, and across the Stalls, Tier 1, and Tier 2 of the Royal Concert Hall.
  • Lift Access: Modern passenger lifts serve all levels of the Royal Concert Hall and connect the Theatre Royal foyers to the Stalls and Dress Circle.
  • Accessible Facilities & Changing Places: The Royal Concert Hall features a full ground-floor Changing Places toilet (with hoist and adult changing bench) alongside accessible toilets across both venues.
  • Assisted Hearing: Sennheiser infrared and induction loop systems are installed in both auditoria, with headsets and neck loops available from the Access Desk.
  • Transport & Parking: The Royal Centre NET Tram stop is step-free directly outside the front doors, with Blue Badge bays on South Sherwood Street and in the Trinity Square car park.
relaxed:
Home to one of the East Midlands' biggest annual pantomimes, major touring musicals, and family concerts, the venue provides dedicated access performances throughout the year.

  • Auditorium Environment: Relaxed pantomime and family performances keep auditorium lighting softly lit, remove pyrotechnics and strobe effects, and reduce sudden volume spikes.
  • Open-Door Policy: Families can freely exit and re-enter the auditorium at any time, supported by trained Access Champions in purple lanyards.
  • Calm Breakout Space: Designated quiet chill-out spaces are set up in the foyers with comfortable seating and sensory resources.
  • Sensory Aids: Visual stories, ear defenders, fidget toys, Touch Tours, and free Essential Companion tickets via the venue's free Access Requirement Register.

name: Nottingham Playhouse
accessibility:
Step-free level access runs directly from Wellington Circus (beside Anish Kapoor's iconic Sky Mirror) into the main foyer, Box Office, bar, and Stalls auditorium.

  • Wheelchair Spaces: Up to 10 wheelchair spaces with adjacent companion seats are available in the Stalls (Row D and Row N) and in the Neville Studio.
  • Lift Access: A passenger lift connects the ground-floor foyer to the Stalls, Circle level, and accessible washrooms.
  • Accessible Facilities: Accessible unisex toilets and baby-changing facilities are located on both the Stalls and Circle levels.
  • Assisted Hearing: Sennheiser radio frequency assistive listening headsets and neck loops are available free of charge from the Box Office.
  • Parking: Blue Badge on-street parking bays are located directly outside the theatre on Wellington Circus and College Street, plus the adjacent Mount Street car park.
relaxed:
Nottingham Playhouse is famous for its award-winning traditional family pantomime, plus a dedicated studio festive production specifically created for children aged 3–8.

  • Auditorium Environment: Dedicated Relaxed and Dementia-Friendly performances feature gently lit house lights, softened sound effects, no pyrotechnics or strobe flashes, and a friendly pre-show introduction from the cast.
  • Open-Door Policy: Audience members are free to move around, vocalise, and leave or re-enter the auditorium at any point.
  • Calm Breakout Space: A dedicated quiet chill-out room with live screen relay of the stage is provided for anyone needing sensory downtime.
  • Sensory Aids: Comprehensive visual stories, sensory/trigger warning sheets, ear defenders, Touch Tours, and free Essential Companion tickets via the Hotlock / Access Pass scheme.

name: Winter Gardens Blackpool
accessibility:
Step-free level access, ramps, and lifts are available throughout the historic Winter Gardens complex, including the Opera House, Pavilion Theatre, and Empress Ballroom via the Church Street and Adelaide Street entrances.

  • Wheelchair Spaces: Dedicated wheelchair positions and companion seats are located in the Stalls of the Opera House and across the main arena spaces.
  • Lift Access: Passenger lifts connect the ground-floor foyers to upper hospitality and accessible viewing areas.
  • Accessible Facilities: Accessible RADAR-key toilets are located throughout the ground-floor concourses and foyers, and assistance dogs are warmly welcomed.
  • Essential Companion: Operates the Nimbus Disability Access Card (Digital Access Pass) scheme, enabling visitors to register their requirements and book accessible seating and free essential companion tickets online.
  • Parking: Blue Badge parking is available in the adjacent Houndshill Shopping Centre and West Street car parks.
relaxed:
As one of the UK's largest receiving houses for blockbuster West End touring musicals, family dance spectacles, and festive productions, accessible performances are scheduled across major runs.

  • Adapted Performances: Relaxed, British Sign Language (BSL) interpreted, Captioned, and Audio Described performances are scheduled in partnership with visiting touring companies—check individual show listings for specific dates.
